title: Gear
description: Canonical, app-owned gear record for the FFG Star Wars RPG. Ingested ONCE from OggDude's `gear` category (606 entries). Mostly descriptive (Type + economics + readable base_mods); no combat stats, no Qualities (verified 0/606). Replaces the runtime SWItems.normalizeGear decode. Per-instance ATTACHMENTS are a separate deferred entity.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — numeric values arrive as STRINGS and coerce to int; Categories rare (6/606) list|scalar; Source scalar OR Sources.Source list -> sources[]; Description markup decoded; Short (13/606) is a one-line blurb; BaseMods.Mod readable MiscDesc -> base_mods (coded mod-keys deferred). Type present on all 606 (required).

type.description: Gear classification from OggDude Type (e.g. 'Communications', 'Tools'). Required (all 606).

pool_mods.description: Extracted dice-pool modifiers at row level (R-DPS-1). Each entry traces back to its source mod object via from.

encumbrance_threshold_bonus.description: Bonus to the wearer's personal encumbrance threshold (e.g. Backpack +4, Utility Belt +1). Stated by the printed page.

threshold_bonus_requires.description: Minimum item state for the encumbrance_threshold_bonus to apply. 'worn' = only when state is worn; 'carried' = when state is worn or carried (not stowed). Adjudicated per-item from the printed page (C-LIM-3).

character_effects.description: Ruling `release-r6-companions-d365` R-R6CD-6 (ADDENDUM 2; D-365, D-378): a CYBERNETIC implant's own effects, page-cited, written by scripts/canonical/apply_cybernetic_effects.py. Only a `type: "Cybernetics"` record carries a cybernetic_effect line (the allOf below); an `item_career_skill` row (`op: "career_skill"`, ruling `release-r7-bug-burndown` ADDENDUM 314 C1/C2) rides any gear type, read by CharResolve.careerSkillStatus while the item is owned. A player reads an in-use implant's lines through CharResolve.itemCharacterEffects (R-R6CD-8; only the four item ops move a player number, under the cybernetic cap R-R6CD-4); companions.js droidOf's cybernetic_add applies all nine to a droid.
